summary: Onconetix (Buyer) filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment, dated November 4, 2026, to its February 11, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with Realbotix Corp. (Parent), Simulacra Corporation (Seller, a Parent subsidiary), and Realbotix, LLC. The amendment sets that if Net Cash falls below $12.5 million and the parties still close, Seller will own 95% of Onconetix's fully diluted shares; Net Cash now includes cash, equivalents, and unpaid principal plus accrued interest under a September 11, 2026 Grid Promissory Note between Buyer and Parent; and the End Date extends to March 31, 2027. Watch regulatory and shareholder approvals and the reverse-split/ownership overhang.
